pageDescription: The applications Keigan watches, and how far each one is through onboarding.

empty.title: No applications yet
empty.description: Onboard the first application to start teaching Keigan how it runs.
empty.noMatchDescription: Try a different name or code.

create.title: Onboard an application
create.description: Keigan creates the application as a draft and shows the two AD groups to request in SailPoint.
create.requestDescription: A Keigan admin reviews your request and starts the onboarding.
create.name: Application name
create.codeHelp: 2 to 10 upper-case letters or digits. Used in the AD group names.
create.codeInvalid: Use 2 to 10 upper-case letters or digits.
create.failed: The application could not be created. Try again.
create.groupsIntro: Request membership of these AD groups in SailPoint so people can see and manage the application.
create.sailpointHint: Groups are provisioned through SailPoint into Entra ID, which can take a short while.

components.label: Components
components.description: Tell Keigan where the application runs: Azure, hardware, mainframe or SaaS.

services.label: Services
services.description: The units Keigan monitors. Review what was discovered and add the rest.

log_tools.label: Log and monitoring tools
log_tools.description: Connect Elastic, Splunk, Datadog and other tools once and reuse them across services.

knowledge.label: Knowledge base
knowledge.description: Let Copilot write the code context, then upload it with architecture diagrams and guides.

topology.label: Topology review
topology.description: Check Keigan's picture of how the services connect. Review it, do not approve it.

runbooks.label: Runbooks
runbooks.description: Known issues and the team's documented response, matched to future incidents.

incidents.label: Incidents and alerts
incidents.description: Where incidents and alerts for this application come from.

slo.label: SLOs
slo.description: Reliability targets Keigan measures from the data it can read.

notifications.label: Notifications
notifications.description: Who hears about incidents, in which channel and language.

access.label: Access
access.description: The AD groups that control who can see and manage this application.

review.label: Review and go live
review.description: Check the checklist and start watching.

readinessNext.monitored_service: turn monitoring on for a service
readinessNext.incident_intake: add an assignment group or alert source

requirements.components: At least one component with verified access
requirements.monitored_service: At least one service with monitoring on ({{count}})
requirements.telemetry_source: At least one telemetry source passed a read test ({{count}})
requirements.incident_intake: A ServiceNow assignment group or an alert source ({{count}})

goodToKnow.diagnostic_settings_one: {{count}} service has no diagnostic setting yet
goodToKnow.diagnostic_settings_other: {{count}} services have no diagnostic setting yet
goodToKnow.diagnostic_settings_done: All discovered services send logs to a workspace
goodToKnow.topology_reviewed: The topology has not been reviewed yet
goodToKnow.placeholder_integrations_one: {{count}} log tool is saved but its reader is not available yet
goodToKnow.placeholder_integrations_other: {{count}} log tools are saved but their reader is not available yet
goodToKnow.placeholder_integrations_done: All log tools can be read
goodToKnow.observe_mode: Alert noise reduction is in Observe mode

banners.requestedBody: This onboarding request has been sent. A Keigan admin will accept it and the workspace unlocks.
banners.pausedBody: Keigan has stopped polling incidents, collecting SLIs and sending notifications until it is resumed.
banners.readOnly: You have read-only access to this application. Ask an admin to make changes.

review.goodToKnowDescription: Facts, not problems. None of these block go-live.
review.goLiveBlocked: Complete the required items above to go live.
review.goLiveDescription: Going live starts all of the following:

starts.polling: ServiceNow incident polling for the assignment groups
starts.predictive: Predictive analysis and the Keigan Intelligence Report
starts.notifications: Stakeholder notifications and Teams incident chats

review.liveBody: Keigan is watching it. You can still edit every step from the navigation.
review.pausedBody: Resume it to restart polling, collection and notifications.
review.actionFailed: That did not work. Try again.
